root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before assigning `sblock->status_flags = (uint8_t)status_flags`, the legacy superblock parser must enforce `status_flags <= 255`; otherwise it accepts a malformed 32-bit status word and continues into downstream metadata parsing that the fixed program rejects at this site.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the stock crashing witness the vulnerable parser decodes `status_flags == 0xffff1a01`, truncates it to one byte, and still reaches the wrapped object-header length computation. The authoritative fixed image rejects that original witness at the added status-flag check, while the adjacent `status_flags_byte_only` mutation keeps the same downstream bytes but makes `raw_status_flags == 1`, providing the genuine fixed-side witness that the guard is the missing source obligation.

nodes.description: `H5O__cache_get_final_load_size()` wraps the computed object-header image length below `H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM`, leaving fewer bytes than the checksum helper will later decode.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `load_size_wrap.actual_len < load_size_wrap.checksum_width`.

nodes.description: `H5C__load_entry()` commits to that wrapped length by reallocating the root object-header image buffer using the short `actual_len` value.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `load_size_wrap.actual_len == load_entry_realloc.actual_len` at the `H5MM_realloc` site.

nodes.description: Immediately before `UINT32DECODE(chk_p, *s_chksum)`, the stored-checksum pointer already points one byte before the heap-backed object-header image buffer.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `checksum_decode_sink.chk_p < checksum_decode_sink.buf`.

edges.relation: The wrapped object-header length computed in `H5O__cache_get_final_load_size()` is forwarded unchanged into `H5C__load_entry()`, where it becomes the size argument that shrinks the image buffer.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `load_size_wrap.actual_len == load_entry_realloc.actual_len`.

edges.relation: The same short length committed at the realloc site is then passed as `len` into `H5O__cache_verify_chksum()` for checksum verification.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `load_entry_realloc.actual_len == checksum_verify_call.verify_len`.

edges.relation: `H5O__cache_verify_chksum()` forwards that same short image length into `H5F_get_checksums()` as `buf_size`, so the checksum helper computes its stored-checksum pointer from a buffer shorter than `H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `checksum_verify_call.verify_len == checksum_decode_sink.buf_size`.
